commands.script:
$a29 = 'D:\1800\.local\stages\a29-independent-20261023\final-v1-review-01\unpacked with spaces\A29-v1.0.0-lesson2-local-win64'
$doneA29 = Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "$a29/DELIVERY_STATUS.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
$summaryA29 = Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 $doneA29.completed_input_readonly.frozen_batch_summary | ConvertFrom-Json
$manifestDigestA29 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $doneA29.completed_input_readonly.frozen_manifest).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if ($manifestDigestA29 -ne $doneA29.completed_input_readonly.manifest_sha256) { throw 'COMPLETED_MANIFEST_REFERENCE_MISMATCH' }
[pscustomobject]@{status='READONLY_COMPLETED_REFERENCES_RESOLVED';lessonCount=$doneA29.actual_lesson_count;denominator=$doneA29.lesson_denominator;formalActual=$doneA29.formal_actual_acceptance;nativeAtBuild=$doneA29.native_display_acceptance_at_build;frozenSummaryStatus=$summaryA29.status;manifestSha256=$manifestDigestA29;productionDefault=$doneA29.default_production_inputs;automaticReplay=$doneA29.automatic_replay_allowed} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
exit 0

$a29 = 'D:\1800\.local\stages\a29-independent-20261023\final-v1-review-01\unpacked with spaces\A29-v1.0.0-lesson2-local-win64'
$reviewTokens=$null
$reviewErrors=$null
$reviewAst=[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile("$a29/operations/02-run-explicit-new-input.ps1.txt",[ref]$reviewTokens,[ref]$reviewErrors)
if($reviewErrors.Count -ne 0){throw 'PRODUCTION_DOCUMENT_PARSE_ERROR'}
$reviewCalls=@($reviewAst.FindAll({param($node) $node -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.CommandAst] -and $node.Extent.Text.StartsWith('& $pythonA29 ')},$true))
if($reviewCalls.Count -ne 1){throw 'EXPECTED_SINGLE_EXPLICIT_HOLDER_COMMAND'}
$reviewCall=$reviewCalls[0].Extent.Text
if(-not $reviewCall.Contains('run_usense_owned.py') -or -not $reviewCall.Contains('batch -- @runArgsA29')){throw 'PRODUCTION_HOLDER_BINDING_MISSING'}
[pscustomobject]@{status='PRODUCTION_DOCUMENT_PARSED_NOT_EXECUTED';parseErrors=$reviewErrors.Count;holderCalls=$reviewCalls.Count;command=$reviewCall} | ConvertTo-Json
exit 0
